proposal.reason: Primary change is adding a new built-in TROCE GIN backend (device/host GIN APIs, context lifecycle, registration, dispatch, and SignalSet/flush semantics), which squarely belongs to gin. Add network because the PR also makes independently substantive shared IB transport changes (provider detection/classification, provider enum expansion, and QP inline/verbs behavior in common net_ib paths) beyond a purely local caller update.
